# who-iris-references

The reference lists of the held IRIS documents, one `folio-reference/v1` node per cited work. Owner, 2026-11-11: "i want all who-iris docs that have references put into their own biblio". Written by the Tool `references-extract` (step `Task_References` of folio-assistant-core's `ingest-build-l1-kg.bpmn`) from each library entry's L1 sections: keyed `<doc-id>.<section>.<n>`, `provenance: extracted`, `derivedFrom` the section file, `printed` the entry verbatim. The bibliography page lists them under the document they came from (`bibliography/library/<doc-id>/`). Regenerated, not hand-edited: re-run the tool after a section is re-derived.

Part of [WHO IRIS](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `who-iris-references`, holding `references`.

_More than 150 files directly here, too many to list, of these kinds: .json._
